trusted_revocation_authority: Host-runner Docker exec control into broker container; intentionally NOT exposed on worker Unix socket. Host/Docker privileges are trusted assumptions, not externally enrolled operator proof.

expected_two_scenarios: revocation_first: forged HMAC rejected, trusted admin revoke commits, stolen-key signed grant denied, wrong host UID denied; zero mock effects

expected_shared_mounts: Broker rw /ipc and rw /private; worker readonly /ipc and readonly /worker.py, plus readonly session key for stolen/legitimate worker. No private mount in workers.
trust_assumptions: Linux host, Docker daemon, host runner with Docker permissions and broker owner trusted
